definitions.explanation: Each and every weekend; recurring on Saturdays and Sundays. Combines {毎|まい} (every) with {週末|しゅうまつ} (weekend).

examples.japanese: {毎週末|まいしゅうまつ}{山|やま}に{登|のぼ}る。
{毎週末|まいしゅうまつ}、{家族|かぞく}と{過|す}ごしている。
examples.english: I spend every weekend with my family.

examples.japanese: {毎週末|まいしゅうまつ}{欠|か}かさずジムに{通|かよ}って{体|からだ}を{鍛|きた}えている。
examples.english: I go to the gym every single weekend without fail to train my body.

notes:
Functions adverbially without a particle: {毎週末|まいしゅうまつ}{出|で}かける.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {毎週末|まいしゅうまつ}{出|で}かける: to go out every weekend
- {毎週末|まいしゅうまつ}{欠|か}かさず: every weekend without fail

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {毎週|まいしゅう}: every week
- {週末|しゅうまつ}ごとに: on each weekend — more explicit 'every single one'
